CustomObject.description: Published by the SmokeTestOrchestrator when the full smoke test suite finishes. Consumed by the AlertRoutingService to send notifications per SmokeTestAlertRoute__mdt configuration, by the WebhookCallbackHandler to fire outbound webhooks, and by the SmokeTestDashboard LWC to finalize the results view. Carries the overall pass/fail outcome, security score result, and rollback recommendation.
CustomObject.label: Smoke Test Complete
